issues.where: bright sky strip between the low sun and the foreground bud
issues.what: The pale glow has a straight horizontal edge and a squared-off right end just left of the bud, visible even in the reduced whole frame.
issues.fix: Remove the hard boundary in the glow and blend its falloff continuously across the sky behind the bud.

issues.what: Several adjacent petals carry nearly identical, evenly spaced orange grooves along smooth blades. The regular striping and sharply cut tips make them read as molded pieces.
issues.fix: Vary the ridges and thickness per petal, and add finer irregular folds and softer, slightly uneven tips.

issues.where: crops 1 and 2, narrow green folds across the middle of the bud
issues.what: The dark green folds flatten into stacked, sharply tapered strips with little surface relief or edge thickness at the overlaps.
issues.fix: Give the folds shallow curvature, tapered edge thickness, and soft contact shading where they overlap.

issues.where: crop 7, broad foreground leaves along the left and lower edges
issues.what: Several leaf tips retain long, straight triangular edges and abrupt planar folds even through the foreground blur. The same silhouettes are visible in the 45.0 s near-neighbor crop.
issues.fix: Break up the straight outlines with irregular margins and tip curl, and soften the creases with curved geometry.
